texts.r:skill:e.e1.alpha: Okwu dị mfe icheta mgbe ị matara ụda mbụ ha na mkpụrụedemede mbụ ha. Kwuo ụda ndị ahụ n'olu dara ụda mgbe ị na-agụ.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.greet: Mgbe ị zutere onye, sị **Hello**. Mgbe ị na-apụ, sị **Goodbye**. Kwuo aha gị site na **My name is ...**.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.numcol: Mụta okwu ọnụọgụ dị ka one, two, three... na okwu agba dị ka red, blue, yellow...
texts.r:skill:e.e1.family: mother (mum), father (dad), grandmother (grandma), baby (nwa nta nke ukwuu): ndị a bụ okwu maka ndị ezinụlọ gị.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.class: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Kwuo ihe ndị dị n'klaasị gị n'asụsụ Bekee.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.noun: Okwu ndị na-akpọ ihe, dị ka rabbit (anụmanụ nwere ntị ogologo), bird (anụmanụ na-efe efe) na fish (anụmanụ na-egwu mmiri), ka a na-akpọ **mkpọaha**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.verb: Okwu ndị na-egosi omume, dị ka jump (ịrị elu n'ikuku), run (ịga ngwa ngwa) na eat (iri nri), ka a na-akpọ **ngwaa**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.like: **I like ...** pụtara na ị na-enwe ọṅụ n'ihe. **I have ...** pụtara na ihe bụ nke gị.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.sent: Mgbe I gasịrị, jiri **am**. Mgbe You gasịrị, jiri **are**. Ahịrịokwu na-esote usoro a: 'onye → ihe ha bụ / ihe ha na-eme'.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.read: Mgbe ị na-agụ, buru ụzọ chọọ okwu ndị dị n'ajụjụ ahụ n'ederede ahụ.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.build: A na-ahazi ahịrịokwu n'usoro a: 'onye → na-eme → gịnị'. Mgbe He, She ma ọ bụ aha onye gasịrị, tinye **-s** na ngwaa.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.pron: Kama aha, ị pụrụ iji **He**, **She**, **It**, **They** ma ọ bụ **We**.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.tense: Maka ihe na-eme ugbu a ma ọ bụ ugboro ugboro, jiri **oge ugbu a**. Maka ihe emeworo, jiri **oge gara aga**: tinye **-ed** n'ikpeazụ ngwaa.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.routine: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Kwuo ihe ị na-eme kwa ụbọchị n'Bekee.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.read: Gụọ ederede ahụ ma chọpụta onye mere gịnị, na mgbe.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.abc1: Mkpụrụedemede nwere **mkpụrụedemede ukwu** na **mkpụrụedemede obere**. Ọtụtụ ụzọ abụọ dị iche n'anya, ya mere mụta ha otu ụzọ n'otu oge. Lezie anya nke ọma n'mkpụrụedemede ndị yiri onwe ha, dị ka b, d, p na q.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.snd1: A na-ejikọ ụda mbụ nke okwu na mkpụrụedemede mbụ ya. Chọọ okwu ndị malitere n'otu ụda iji mụta otú ụda na ndapụta okwu si metụta. Mgbe ụfọdụ mkpụrụedemede abụọ, dị ka ph, na-eme ụda f.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.tense: Maka ugbu a ma ọ bụ omenala, jiri **oge ugbu a**. Maka oge gara aga, tinye **-ed**. Maka ihe ị ga-eme, jiri **will + ngwaa isi**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.qneg: Malite ajụjụ na **Do/Does**. Iji kwuo mba, jiri **don't/doesn't**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.adj: Okwu dị ka big, small, hot na cold na-akọwa otú ihe na-adị anya ma ọ bụ na-adị ọnụ.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.prep: Jiri **on**, **in**, **under** na **behind** kwuo ebe ihe nọ.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.read: Chọta onye mere gịnị, na ebe, n'ederede, wee zaa.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.gram: Jiri **an** tupu ụda ụdaume na **a** tupu ụda mgbochiume. Maka otu ihe, jiri **There is**. Maka ọtụtụ ihe, jiri **There are**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.comp: Iji tụnyere ihe abụọ, jiri **-er + than**. Maka 'nke kacha', jiri **the -est**. Maka okwu ogologo, jiri **more**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.future: Maka ihe ị ga-eme, jiri **will + ngwaa isi** ma ọ bụ **be going to + ngwaa isi**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.transform: Maka ịjụ, jiri **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Maka ajụjụ, tinye **Are / Do / Does** n'mmalite ahịrịokwu.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.read: Ederede ogologo dị mfe ma ị chọta onye, ebe, mgbe na gịnị, dị ka a ga-asị na ị na-etinye ahịrị n'okpuru ha.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.tense: Maka ihe na-eme ugbu a, jiri **be + -ing**. Maka oge gara aga, jiri **oge gara aga**. Maka ọdịnihu, jiri **will / be going to**.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.modal: **can** (nwee ike), **must** (ga-eme), **should** (ọ dị mma ime), **may** (ọ dị mma) na-esote udi isi nke ngwaa.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.vocab: Mụta okwu nwere ihe ọ pụtara yiri onwe ha na ndị megidere ha ọnụ, okwu gị ga-abawanye okpukpu abụọ.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.clause: Jikọọ ahịrịokwu site na **because** (ihe kpatara), **so** (nsonaazụ), **but** (ọdịiche), **if** (ọnọdụ) na **when** (oge).
texts.r:skill:e.e6.read: Gụọ ederede nwere ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu ma chọta onye mere ihe, mgbe na ihe kpatara.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.seq1: Okwu ndị na-egosi usoro, dị ka **First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** na **Finally**, na-agwa gị usoro ihe mere.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.pun1: Ahịrịokwu na-amalite na **mkpụrụedemede ukwu** ma na-akwụsị na **akara mkpọpụta** kwesịrị ekwesị: ntụpọ (.) maka nkwupụta, akara ajụjụ (?) maka ajụjụ, na akara mkpu (!) maka ijuanya ma ọ bụ mmetụta siri ike. Aha mmadụ na okwu I na-eji mkpụrụedemede ukwu mgbe niile.
texts.r:skill:e.vocab: Mụta okwu a na-ahụkarị site na **ụda + ihe ọ pụtara + ndapụta okwu** ọnụ, ị ga-echeta ha ogologo oge. Pịa bọtịnụ ọkpụkpọ olu iji nụ ka ha si dị.
texts.r:skill:e.be: Ngwaa be na-agbanwe udi ya na isiokwu. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
texts.r:skill:e.pres: Mgbe isiokwu bụ **he / she / it (onye nke atọ nanị otu)**, tinye **-s / -es** na ngwaa. Okwu na-akwụsị na -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o na-eburu -es. Maka mgbochiume + y, gbanwee y ka ọ bụrụ i ma tinye -es!
texts.r:skill:e.plural: Maka abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa, tinye **-s** na mkpọaha n'ozuzu. Mkpọaha na-akwụsị na -x na-eburu **-es**. Mụta ọnụọgụ ọtụtụ na-adịghị mma site n'obi. Ahịrịokwu na-aga **isiokwu → ngwaa → ihe fọdụrụ**.
texts.r:skill:e.order: Maka abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa, tinye **-s** na mkpọaha n'ozuzu. Mkpọaha na-akwụsị na -x na-eburu **-es**. Mụta ọnụọgụ ọtụtụ na-adịghị mma site n'obi. Ahịrịokwu na-aga **isiokwu → ngwaa → ihe fọdụrụ**.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.perf: have/has + past participle. Ọ na-egosi ahụmịhe, ọgwụgwụ ma ọ bụ nnọgidesi ike. Mata ọdịiche dị n'etiti since (oge ụfọdụ) na for (ogologo oge).
texts.r:skill:e.m2.pass: Jiri be + past participle ikwu na e mere ihe n'onye ma ọ bụ ihe. Tinye onye na-eme ya na by.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.inf: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V na-egosi ebumnuche, ma stop + V-ing pụtara ịkwụsị omume.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.comp: -er/-est na more/most. Jiri than na comparative na the na superlative. good → better → best adịghị agbaso iwu.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.read: Buru ụzọ gụọ ajụjụ ahụ, mgbe ahụ chọta ahịrịokwu ntụpọ aka. Aha na isi echiche na-ekpuchi ederede ahụ niile.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.sum1: Iji chịkọta, chọta **isi echiche** ma mee ka ọ bụrụ otu ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ abụọ. Ahịrịokwu banyere naanị otu nkọwa, nke na-agbakwunye ihe na-adịghị n'ederede, ma ọ bụ nke sara mbara nke ukwuu abụghị ezigbo nchịkọta.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.rel: Jikọọ ahịrịokwu abụọ ka ọ bụrụ otu site na who (mmadụ), which (ihe), that (abụọ) na whose (ịnwe).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.cond: If + oge ugbu a, will + V (ihe ga-ekwe omume). If + oge gara aga, would + V (iche ihe na-abụghị eziokwu ugbu a).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.ques: Jiri usoro okwu ajụjụ + onye na-eme + ngwaa. Ejila do/does/did.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.part: -ing bụ nke na-aga n'ihu ma ọ bụ na-eme; -ed bụ nke e meere ma ọ bụ nke gwụchara. Maka mmetụta, jiri -ing maka ihe na-akpata mmetụta ahụ na -ed maka onye na-enwe ya.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.read: Gbakọta ihe ngosi iji mee mkpebi n'echiche. Kpebie ebumnuche ederede site n'ilele arịrịọ na nkwupụta ya.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.tense: had + p.p. bụ maka ihe merenụ tupu ihe ọzọ gara aga. have been -ing bụ maka omume gara n'ihu ruo ugbu a.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.clause: where / when / why bụ okwu njikọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka adverb. whether / that na-ewebata ahịrịokwu aha.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.partc: Hapụ njikọ na onye na-eme ihe, ma gbanwee ngwaa ka ọ bụrụ -ing. Onye na-eme ihe ga-abụrịrị otu n'akụkụ abụọ ahụ.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.conn: Mata ihe dị iche n'etiti ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ (so, therefore), mmegide (however), ọmụmaatụ (for example) na mgbakwunye (in addition).
texts.r:skill:e.h1.main: Echiche bụ isi na-abịakarị n'azụ However, nke na-atụgharị nkwenye a na-ahụkarị, na n'ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ. Dejupụta oghere site n'ịgbaso usoro nsogbu → ngwọta → nsonaazụ.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.inv: Mgbe Never/Hardly/Only then bụ nke mbụ, usoro na-aghọ ngwaa enyemaka + onye na-eme ihe. Jiri It is ~ that maka mmesi ike.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.subj: N'ahịrịokwu I wish / as if / If, jiri oge gara aga maka mmegide nke ugbu a na had p.p. maka mmegide nke oge gara aga.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.wh: whatever, whoever, whichever na however + nkọwaaha pụtara 'n'agbanyeghị gịnị / onye / nke / ka ... '.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.vocab: Chee ihe okwu ọhụrụ pụtara site n'ihe ngosi nke mmegide, ọmụmaatụ na ihe kpatara, na site n'mkpụrụ mbido ya.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.logic: Soro ederede ahụ site n'ịmara ihe okwu ntụpọ na-ezo aka na ya na okwu njikọ. Gbakọta nkọwa ndị ahụ iji ruo mkpebi.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.par: Ahịrịokwu ndị and/but/or jikọtara na-eweta otu udi. Ngwaa na-ekwekọ na onye na-eme ihe bụ isi.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.tone: Chọta ọnọdụ obi site n'okwu nkọwa na ndị metụtara mmetụta. Chọta ebumnuche site n'ịlele ma ederede na-ajụ, na-enye ozi ma ọ bụ na-eme ka a kwenye.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.ins: Jiri okwu njikọ, okwu ntụpọ na usoro oge dị ka ihe ngosi iji hazie ahịrịokwu ma chọta ebe e nyere ahịrịokwu kwesịrị.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.col: Mụta ụzọ okwu na-eso onwe ha, dị ka make a decision, take a risk na heavy rain. Chee ihe okwu ntụnyere pụtara site n'ọnọdụ.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.sum: Chọta echiche bụ isi na okwu mmegide n'ederede ahụ ma mee ka ha dị mkpụmkpụ n'otu ahịrịokwu.
texts.r:skill:e.h.conv: N'ajụjụ mkparịta ụka, lelee ọ bụghị naanị na ụtọasụsụ ziri ezi kamakwa na ụda olu dị mma ma dị ugwu n'ọnọdụ ahụ. Onyinye, ịkwụsị okwu, ịzaghachi otuto, nkwuwa okwu na okwu a na-akpọghachi na-apụta ugboro ugboro.
texts.r:skill:e.h.job: N'asụsụ Bekee ọrụ, isi ihe bụ nkwuwa okwu (touch base), mkpụmkpụ okwu (ASAP, wdg.) na nkwekọrịta ngwaa-mkpụrụokwu (collocations). Ejila okwu tụgharịa okwu ka okwu; cheta ha dị ka ngwakọta a na-eji n'ọnọdụ ọrụ.
texts.r:skill:e.h.media: N'asụsụ Bekee mgbasa ozi, ọ dị mkpa ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti eziokwu na echiche na ikpe ma ezi uche dị na nkwupụta ziri ezi. Cheta okwu dị ka nkọwa eserese (alt text, caption) na ngwa nchịkọta dị ka ebumnuche ha si dị.
texts.r:skill:e.h.world: Maka isiokwu omenala ụwa, mụta okwu bụ isi dị ka culture, diversity na stereotype, na nkwuwa okwu maka ịnwa ịghọta omenala ndị ọzọ n'enweghị ikpe ha. Mata ọdịiche okwu ndị yiri onwe ha site na ntụpọ nke ọnọdụ.
texts.r:skill:e.h.lit: N'ajụjụ akwụkwọ ndị edemede, isi ihe bụ ịmara nkọwa nke okwu ma tinye ya n'ihe omume n'akụkọ. Debe foreshadowing, symbol, point of view, theme na ọrụ àgwà dị iche.
texts.r:skill:e.h.debate: Arụmụka chọrọ ịmata ọdịiche okwu (motion, rebuttal, wdg.), ụdị ihe akaebe na ndudue ezi uche. Mgbe ị na-enyocha nkwupụta, buru ụzọ jụọ, "Gịnị bụ ihe akaebe maka nke a?"
texts.r:skill:e.h.write: N'ide, họrọ ụdị kwekọrọ n'ebumnuche na onye na-agụ, ma lelee akụkụ ahịrịokwu (isiokwu na ngwaa) na ezi uche nke njikọ. Maka ederede pụrụ iche dị ka resume, omume na ọnụọgụ dị mma karịa okwu na-edoghị anya.
